about: Every line the game shows, with the value on the official NHL source and on hockey-reference.com, both read on the date above. The Hall of Fame year has hhof.com as a third source. Written by Round 923; scripts/simNhlCareerPathFacts.mjs pins the data file to this record word for word.

sources.official: api-web.nhle.com, the NHL feed behind nhl.com/player/<id>: draftDetails, careerTotals.regularSeason, seasonTotals (NHL, regular season), awards, inHHOF, birthCountry, birthCity.
sources.second: hockey-reference.com player page: the meta block (position, birthplace, draft, Hall of Fame line), the NHL totals row of the regular season table, the NHL season rows, and the Recognition list.
sources.third: hhof.com player inductees by year, for the induction year.

rules.position: Forward for C, LW, RW; Defense; Goalie. Both sources.
rules.country: Country of birth in present-day borders; the NHL birthCountry and the hockey-reference birthplace (USSR and Czechoslovakia births resolve by city, which both sources give).
rules.draftInfo: 'Nth Round, Nth Overall (YYYY)' from both draft records; a player with no NHL draft on either source shows 'Undrafted (NHL debut YYYY-YY)' with the first NHL regular season on both.
rules.teams: NHL regular season teams in order of first appearance, named as the official NHL source names them (accents folded, the 1979 Winnipeg suffix dropped). Both sources give the same order.
rules.stats: Career NHL regular season. Retired skaters: exact G, A, Pts. Active skaters: each total rounded down to a ten, below the lower of the two sources. Retired goalies: W, GAA, SV%. Active goalies: W and GP rounded down to a ten, SO rounded down to a five.
rules.awards: Up to four lines: the trophies the old row named when they hold on both sources, then by importance, and the Hall of Fame year last when NHL inHHOF is 1 and hockey-reference and hhof.com give the same year. A single Stanley Cup shows without a year (hockey-reference gives the count only). Counts on active players are as of the read date.

order: The array order is deliberate. The daily pick is dailyIndex(dateET, 60) in src/lib/dateUtils.ts, a shuffle per 60 day cycle; the cycle holding the release runs 2026-09-04 to 2026-11-02. The 30 new players sit on the indices dealt 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-02, so a release between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-20 deals only players the old pool never dealt for at least two weeks.

heldOut.name: Peter Bondra
heldOut.why: No NHL trophy on either source (the old Rocket Richard line is false, the trophy began in 1998-99), and the shown country Slovakia is his national team while both sources give a birthplace of Luck, USSR (today Ukraine). Held out rather than shown a guess.

heldOut.name: Felix Potvin
heldOut.why: No NHL trophy on either source; the old award lines were a nickname, a description and a junior award, and his GAA and shutout lines were wrong (2.97 and 18 shown; 2.76 and 32 on both sources). Held out rather than padded.
